odcs.yaml:
apiVersion: "v3.0.2"
kind: "DataContract"
id: "urn:tabularia:datasource:7"
name: "Sales"
version: "3.0.0"
status: "draft"
description:
  purpose: "Sales «net»"
schema:
  - name: "Sales"
    logicalType: "object"
    physicalType: "table"
    description: "the datasource"
    properties:
      - name: "id"
        logicalType: "integer"
        physicalType: "Int64"
        description: "the key"
        quality:
          - type: "text"
            name: "id is of type integer"
            description: "The column id exists and its type is integer."
            dimension: "conformity"
            severity: "error"
            customProperties:
              - property: "tabulariaRuleId"
                value: "r2"
              - property: "tabulariaRuleKind"
                value: "column"
          - type: "library"
            rule: "nullValues"
            name: "id is never null"
            mustBe: 0
            unit: "rows"
            dimension: "completeness"
            severity: "error"
            customProperties:
              - property: "tabulariaRuleId"
                value: "r1"
              - property: "tabulariaRuleKind"
                value: "not_null"
          - type: "library"
            rule: "duplicateCount"
            name: "id is unique"
            mustBe: 0
            unit: "rows"
            dimension: "uniqueness"
            severity: "error"
            customProperties:
              - property: "tabulariaRuleId"
                value: "r3"
              - property: "tabulariaRuleKind"
                value: "unique"
          - type: "sql"
            name: "id is in range"
            description: "Every non-null value is at least 1 and at most 1e+20."
            query: "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ${table} WHERE \"id\" < 1 OR \"id\" > 1e+20"
            mustBe: 0
            unit: "rows"
            dimension: "conformity"
            severity: "error"
            customProperties:
              - property: "tabulariaRuleId"
                value: "r6"
              - property: "tabulariaRuleKind"
                value: "range"
        required: true
        unique: true
        logicalTypeOptions:
          minimum: 1
          maximum: 1e+20
      - name: "code"
        logicalType: "string"
        physicalType: "String"
        logicalTypeOptions:
          pattern: "^[A-Z]{2}\\d+$"
        quality:
          - type: "text"
            name: "code matches the pattern"
            description: "Every non-null value matches the regular expression ^[A-Z]{2}\\d+$ in full."
            dimension: "conformity"
            severity: "warning"
            customProperties:
              - property: "tabulariaRuleId"
                value: "r9"
              - property: "tabulariaRuleKind"
                value: "pattern"
      - name: "day"
        logicalType: "date"
        physicalType: "Date"
        logicalTypeOptions:
          minimum: "2020-01-01"
        quality:
          - type: "sql"
            name: "day is in range"
            description: "Every non-null value is at least 2020-01-01."
            query: "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ${table} WHERE \"day\" < '2020-01-01'"
            mustBe: 0
            unit: "rows"
            dimension: "conformity"
            severity: "error"
            customProperties:
              - property: "tabulariaRuleId"
                value: "r7"
              - property: "tabulariaRuleKind"
                value: "range"
      - name: "state"
        logicalType: "string"
        physicalType: "Categorical"
        quality:
          - type: "sql"
            name: "state has only accepted values"
            description: "Every non-null value is one of: it's, 1, 2.5, True."
            query: "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ${table} WHERE \"state\" IS NOT NULL AND \"state\" NOT IN ('it''s', 1, 2.5, TRUE)"
            mustBe: 0
            unit: "rows"
            dimension: "conformity"
            severity: "error"
            customProperties:
              - property: "tabulariaRuleId"
                value: "r5"
              - property: "tabulariaRuleKind"
                value: "accepted_values"
      - name: "f"
        logicalType: "number"
        physicalType: "Float64"
      - name: "t"
        logicalType: "date"
        physicalType: "Datetime(time_unit='us', time_zone=None)"
      - name: "b"
        logicalType: "boolean"
        physicalType: "Boolean"
      - name: "o"
        physicalType: "Object"
      - name: "n"
      - name: "line\u2028sep\u0085x"
        quality:
          - type: "text"
            name: "line\u2028sep\u0085x is present"
            description: "The column line\u2028sep\u0085x exists."
            dimension: "conformity"
            severity: "warning"
            customProperties:
              - property: "tabulariaRuleId"
                value: "r16"
              - property: "tabulariaRuleKind"
                value: "column"
      - name: "new"
        quality:
          - type: "sql"
            name: "new is in range"
            description: "Every non-null value is at most 3."
            query: "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ${table} WHERE \"new\" > 3"
            mustBe: 0
            unit: "rows"
            dimension: "conformity"
            severity: "error"
            customProperties:
              - property: "tabulariaRuleId"
                value: "r8"
              - property: "tabulariaRuleKind"
                value: "range"
    quality:
      - type: "sql"
        name: "unique combination of a, b\"c"
        description: "No two rows share the same values of a, b\"c (nulls count as values)."
        query: "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT \"a\", \"b\"\"c\" FROM ${table} GROUP BY \"a\", \"b\"\"c\" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS duplicated"
        mustBe: 0
        unit: "rows"
        dimension: "uniqueness"
        severity: "warning"
        customProperties:
          - property: "tabulariaRuleId"
            value: "r4"
          - property: "tabulariaRuleKind"
            value: "unique"
      - type: "library"
        rule: "rowCount"
        name: "row count"
        mustBeGreaterOrEqualTo: 1
        unit: "rows"
        dimension: "completeness"
        severity: "error"
        customProperties:
          - property: "tabulariaRuleId"
            value: "r10"
          - property: "tabulariaRuleKind"
            value: "row_count"
      - type: "library"
        rule: "rowCount"
        name: "row count"
        mustBeLessOrEqualTo: 9
        unit: "rows"
        dimension: "completeness"
        severity: "error"
        customProperties:
          - property: "tabulariaRuleId"
            value: "r11"
          - property: "tabulariaRuleKind"
            value: "row_count"
      - type: "library"
        rule: "rowCount"
        name: "row count"
        mustBeBetween: [1, 9]
        unit: "rows"
        dimension: "completeness"
        severity: "error"
        customProperties:
          - property: "tabulariaRuleId"
            value: "r12"
          - property: "tabulariaRuleKind"
            value: "row_count"
      - type: "text"
        name: "freshness"
        description: "At most 1.5 hours have passed since the newest value of day."
        dimension: "timeliness"
        severity: "warning"
        customProperties:
          - property: "tabulariaRuleId"
            value: "r13"
          - property: "tabulariaRuleKind"
            value: "freshness"
      - type: "text"
        name: "freshness"
        description: "At most 24 hours have passed since the last update of the data."
        dimension: "timeliness"
        severity: "warning"
        customProperties:
          - property: "tabulariaRuleId"
            value: "r14"
          - property: "tabulariaRuleKind"
            value: "freshness"
      - type: "sql"
        name: "condition"
        description: "The condition is true on every row; a null result counts as a violation. SQL dialect: Polars SQL."
        query: "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ${table} WHERE NOT COALESCE((id > 0), FALSE)"
        mustBe: 0
        unit: "rows"
        dimension: "consistency"
        severity: "error"
        customProperties:
          - property: "tabulariaRuleId"
            value: "r15"
          - property: "tabulariaRuleKind"
            value: "expression"
slaProperties:
  - property: "latency"
    value: 1.5
    unit: "h"
    element: "Sales.day"
  - property: "latency"
    value: 24
    unit: "h"
customProperties:
  - property: "tabulariaDatasourceId"
    value: 7
  - property: "tabulariaContractVersion"
    value: 3
contractCreatedTs: "2026-01-02T03:04:05Z"
